scope: New original-source-bound instruction-local ordinary WriteWrite certificate study; all seeds declared before measurement. No GPU execution. Frozen earlier study is unchanged.

protocol.run_order: Sequential random case order per round; adjacent baseline/candidate pair with randomized arm order; fresh processes. No concurrent builds or timing jobs.
protocol.first_sample: Separate first measured process after untimed complete-specification preflight; later processes OS-warm, no cold-cache claim.
protocol.counts: Configurations, not distinct application bug sites. Equal-value original HipKittens conflicts and synthetic unsupported tails do not establish new different-value algorithm coverage.
protocol.latency_denominator: Independently valid detections in both arms only. New certified detection versus UNKNOWN/Unsupported is coverage plus absolute time, not an infinite speedup.
protocol.budgets: No adaptive retry, timeout expansion, outlier removal, changed expectations or changed primary selection after outcomes. Preserve every timeout/crash/miss and both first/repeated samples.
protocol.adoption: Zero false positives/unsafe accepts, every baseline detection/safe proof retained, complete math/output invariance for every common-safe case, all overhead gates, and new certified findings in at least4 algorithm families including2 original-shape complex families. Primary latency changes including ties/failures are reported separately, not substituted after data.
protocol.timing_eligibility: Fixed only from the one baseline qualification: hazard needs an independently justified complete typed property finding; safe needs complete graph, exact outputs and full specification proof. Candidate failure fails a gate and is never filtered away. Successful paired ratios only where both succeed; unqualified cases retain every functional result, timeout/censored runtime and fixed60-second budget without31 undefined-finding repeats. Failed primary qualification remains an explicit failed primary with no substitution. Candidate-only findings get absolute certified time/coverage, no baseline speed ratio. Baseline-unproved safe cases cannot support a safe-proof/overhead guarantee.
